### World Questival is a 12-week program that brings students back to the Library through fun weekly activities, both on campus and online.
![the photos showing a group of people taking photograph together](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/world-questival/world-questival-main-image.jpg)
Students join a country team and take part in culturally based games that help develop their thinking, learning and reading skills. There will be weekly winners, as well as one Grand Champion at the end of the program.   
  
The program is run in partnership with the Japanese Culture Club, PRIDE Club, Charity and Environment Club and the RMIT Photography Club Hanoi.
## Game rules
The program runs for 12 weeks, with new games every phase.
From Week 9 to 12 Semester 1 and Week 0 to 7 Semester 2/2026.   
  
Students can join any week and play one or more games. More entries per person per game is allowed.   
  
Bi-weekly winners will be announced. Points will be collected to throne the Grand Champion at the end.
## Timelines
![vietnam.jpg](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/world-questival/vietnam.jpg)
### Vietnam – Explore the library
Week 9 – 12 (28 Apr – 24 May)   
  
Let's learn about the library services and how can you make the most of the RMIT's treasures.   
  
Game 1: 360° Ultimate Virtual Library Tour (result released on 11 May)   
Game 2: Vietnam Ơi gameshow (result released on 25 May)   
  
Proudly hosted by The Library team.
![taiwan.jpg](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/world-questival/taiwan.jpg)
### Taiwan – The first country to legalize same-sex marriage
Week 0 – 1 Semester 2 (22 Jun – 5 July)   
  
Participants will explore themes of equality and inclusion through activities inspired by Taiwan’s milestone in LGBTQ+ rights. This week connects cultural understanding with library resources on diversity, identity and social change.   
  
Result released on 6 July.   
  
In collaboration with the RMIT PRIDE Club.
![japan.jpg](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/world-questival/japan.jpg)
### Japan – A country rich in culture and landscape
Week 2 – 3 Semester 2 (6 July – 19 July)   
  
Step into a world where tradition meets modern life. Through interactive activities, participants will explore Japanese culture, literature and everyday experiences. The library will guide your journey with resources on the Japanese language, storytelling and cultural insights.   
  
Result released on 20 July.   
  
In collaboration with the Japanese Culture Club and Charity & Environment Club.
![autralia.jpg](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/world-questival/autralia.jpg)
### Australia – Where RMIT begins
Week 4 – 8 Semester 2 (20 July – 16 August)   
  
As the birthplace of RMIT, Australia represents the university’s roots and learning culture. Inspired by this, participants will capture moments of reading culture in their daily lives — how, where and why they read.
The library supports this journey by promoting reading as part of student life through its spaces, resources and community.   
  
Format: media contest. Result released on week 8/2026.   
  
In collaboration with RMIT Photography Club Hanoi.
## Prizes
![grand-winner.jpg](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/world-questival/grand-winner.jpg)
### Grand winner
Individual with the highest total score across the entire event (12 weeks)
![bi-weekly.jpg](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/world-questival/bi-weekly.jpg)
### Bi-weekly winner
Individual with the highest score of bi- week. Each country will have one bi-weekly individual winner.
Prize will be awarded at the end of the week.
![best-team.jpg](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/world-questival/best-team.jpg)
### Best team winner
+ 5 points (each participant in a team of 3 people, ONE TIME ONLY)
![random-vote.jpg](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/world-questival/random-vote.jpg)
### "Cast your vote" prize
Vote for the winner country
